profiles.name: C2017_ST_Jupiter_parameter_roles_v1
profiles.scope: San_tong_li, Jupiter; declarations versus local computed quantities remain distinct
rules: 見復數 in generic planetary counting denotes Jupiter 見數; 見中法 is explicitly 見數也; 歲數 denotes 歲星歲數 in this planetary scope.
閏分 in the appearance-month procedure denotes the planetary 見閏分, not the civil intercalation remainder.
The declared 積月 and 月餘 are whole and fractional lunations per one appearance; 後月餘 names this declared increment. These are not aliases for every computed 積月/月餘.

profiles.name: C2017_ST_local_year_count_v1
rules: Root epoch_elapsed_years is the elapsed interval before the target year. 外所求年 uses this unchanged. 盡所求年 counts through the target year and uses elapsed years plus one; the conversion is local to this phrase, never a global offset.

profiles.name: C2017_ST_Jupiter_station_rate_v1
rules: For the Year/Jupiter chronological calculation, 145 stations per 144 years is the rate; this is not a dimensionless rate nor a general day-to-angle conversion.
Preserve full accumulated stations and derive independent twelve-station and sixty-year views. 星紀 is station index 1; 丙子 is sexagenary index 13. Zero exhausted-count offset returns the origin.
Station labels are in supplied source order, with whitespace normalization only (實 沈 to 實沈); no new Chinese sentence is appended to the procedure.

profiles.name: C2017_ST_Section_four_Rules_conditional_v1
rules: Within this passage only, accept Cullen’s conditional interpretation that a 篇 is four Rules; 周至 is three Rules.
The corresponding increments are 39 whole cyclical days and 1/81 day, or 59 whole cyclical days and 21/81 day, respectively. They are alternatives applied independently to a specified common base.

This interpretation does not identify which base the user requests, a rule/section ordinal, or whether the initialized state of the preceding procedure is to be consumed. Do not add such a rule as if Cullen stated it.

profiles.name: C2017_ST_origin_month_day_frame_v1
rules: When months are explicitly reduced by Origin Months, their day count is relative to the latest Origin, whose first day is jiazi.1. Preserve this epoch in the corresponding count method.
Cullen §195 instead calls the base Concordance Head. Retain this discrepancy; the fixed root is an Origin boundary and does not discriminate these readings.

profiles.name: C2017_ST_concordance_midnight_frame_v1
rules: A Concordance begins with conjunction and winter solstice coinciding at midnight of the first Celestial month. A task that explicitly requests the zero-th Rule from this head selects that instant.
This calendar origin fact does not imply that §266 historically requests that particular initial instant; the task must declare its ordinal separately.
